description.value: BNA Brewing Co. & Eatery is a locally owned craft brewery and full-service eatery that has operated since 2015 out of a restored 100-year-old warehouse in downtown Kelowna. The Kelowna flagship brews all of its beer on-site and pairs it with a kitchen menu of culturally-inspired dishes, from Filipino fried rice to wood-fired pizza. The venue also houses six 10-pin bowling lanes, making it a lively destination stop rather than just a quick refuel.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms BNA Brewing Co. & Eatery is an active, multi-location craft brewery and eatery; the Kelowna flagship at 1250 Ellis Street with phone (236) 420-0025 is clearly operational based on live menus, reservations, and bowling bookings. The OSM name 'BNA Eatery' is a shortened version of the full business name 'BNA Brewing Co. & Eatery' per the website. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or most optional amenities was found in the website content, so those remain null; growler fills and 4-packs are cited as evidence for takeout.
concerns: OSM name 'BNA Eatery' is a shortened variant; the business's own website consistently uses 'BNA Brewing Co. & Eatery'.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website (1250 Ellis Street, Kelowna, BC V1Y1Z4; (236) 420-0025) and could not be cross-confirmed against OSM values.
OSM amenity tag is 'pub'; the business is more accurately a craft brewery with a full eatery and bowling alley.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established craft brewery and eatery in downtown Kelowna with on-site brewing, a full food menu, and takeout beer options — a clear and worthwhile stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan. Meets Food & Drink category fit.
